response.rationale: The presence of EBV-positive cells, along with CD138-positive and CD56-positive markers, strongly supports the diagnosis of Extranodal NK/T-cell lymphoma, nasal type, EBV-positive, making it the champion. R3 is the runner-up due to similar support but lacks the explicit EBV-positive mention in its label.

rejected.why: CD20-negative and PAX5-negative contradict typical B-cell lymphoma markers, and CD56 positivity is not typical for Plasmablastic lymphoma
